title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic: Managed Agents bind to private MCP servers + Claude Platform on AWS
bullets.summary: Managed Agents run in a sandbox you control and connect to private MCP servers; Claude Platform on AWS; Slack tagging. (Fable 5 shipped Jun 9, export-suspended Jun 12.)
bullets.how: Managed Agents + private MCP is exactly The Construct's wiring.

bullets.title: Agent-callable image/video MCP servers — Pixa, Imagine, Higgsfield
bullets.summary: Pixa MCP exposes 6 tools in Claude (text-to-video via Kling/Luma/Hailuo); Imagine + Higgsfield add 30+ models, 4K stills, 15s video.
bullets.how: Brief-to-signage-video and product shots with zero custom code.

bullets.title: DeepSeek V4-Pro / V4-Flash (open-weight MoE, 1M context)
bullets.summary: Hybrid-attention MoE optimized for long-running agentic tasks at sharply lower inference cost.
bullets.how: Cost cut on long-horizon/batch jobs; open-weight self-host option.

bullets.title: Frontier compression: OpenAI GPT-5.5 + Google Gemini 3.5 Flash
bullets.summary: GPT-5.5 SOTA on agentic coding/computer-use (Terminal-Bench 2.0 82.7%); Gemini 3.5 Flash agentic-optimized, 4x faster output.
bullets.how: Benchmark our coding/computer-use agents; Gemini Flash for fast batch image/text.

bullets.title: Convey $38M Series A (a16z) — 'AI teammates' for non-technical operators
bullets.summary: Lets non-engineers build autonomous workflows (NBCUniversal, Samsara); Taktile raised $110M for AI decisioning.
bullets.how: Positioning signal for PRAGMA's operator model; watch the non-technical-operator wedge.

praxis_lesson: MCP is now the load-bearing standard on both sides — Anthropic lets Managed Agents bind to private MCP servers, and every gen-media vendor ships one. The Construct's move: expose our own capabilities AS MCP servers (outbound), not just consume them, turning integration from a project into a config line.
